translations.web: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone?’
translations.bsb: But Jesus looked directly at them and said, “Then what is the meaning of that which is written: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’?
translations.kjv: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
translations.asv: But he looked upon them, and said, What then is this that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner?
